commentary: Market breadth at a frail score of 14 alongside an explicit WEAK gate signals persistent institutional distribution under William O'Neil's market direction framework. Stan Weinstein's stage discipline dictates extreme caution when headline benchmarks face heavy distribution, foreign institutional outflows exceed ₹1,00,000 crore, and rallies stall beneath descending moving averages. In such environments, Jesse Livermore's timeless guidance—respect the general market and trade only undisputed leaders—must govern every decision. Mark Minervini's progressive exposure rules require preserving capital and demanding pristine alignment of Stage 2 technical pivots with genuine CANSLIM earnings acceleration before committing risk. Candidates lacking confirmed earnings momentum must be relegated to watchlists, keeping cash reserves high and stop losses uncompromising.
limitations: Daily scan observations are not fills or performance results.
Price levels are scanner references, not live quotes.

analysis.analyst: Minervini SEPA, O'Neil CANSLIM, Weinstein Stage Analysis & Livermore Tape Discipline

ANANDRATHI.technical: Constructive consolidation near its 20-session pivot at 2270.67 on 2.08× average volume. Price holds firmly above rising 21-EMA, 50-SMA, and 200-SMA in a healthy Stage 2 advance with an RSI of 67, demonstrating clear relative strength against a distributing market.
ANANDRATHI.fundamental: Capital-light franchise generates elite 45.3% ROE and 57.5% ROCE with zero debt and high OPM near 49%. However, recent quarterly PAT contracted 10.7% YoY, failing CANSLIM's 25% acceleration requirement.
ANANDRATHI.risk: Close below the 2171.37 stop or loss of 50-SMA invalidates the pivot structure; cut loss immediately.

ANTELOPUS.technical: Powerful Stage 2 advance clearing a double-bottom neckline at 1292.19 on 4.05× volume. Price trades cleanly above EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200 with RSI at 54, reflecting strong institutional accumulation and constructive contraction along the right side of the base.
ANTELOPUS.fundamental: Stellar CANSLIM acceleration driven by post-merger hydrocarbon monetization. Operating margins exceed 55% with net margins expanding rapidly on zero long-term debt, validating high-velocity earnings momentum and institutional demand.
ANTELOPUS.risk: Break below neckline stop at 1164.98 or breakdown below 50-SMA invalidates breakout thesis; cut losses decisively.

CHENNPETRO.technical: Double-bottom rebound pressing against its 1679.18 trigger on 2.04× volume. Moving averages are aligned above rising EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200 with RSI at 59, but relative strength remains choppy given broader commodity sector drag.
CHENNPETRO.fundamental: Gross refining margins fuel a sharp Q1 revenue and PAT rebound from prior-year loss, but multi-quarter earnings track record is erratic. Cyclical margin sensitivity and debt exposure fail strict CANSLIM stability filters.
CHENNPETRO.risk: Breach of double-bottom pivot low at 1497.66 shatters setup; exit immediately per Minervini risk rules.

CRISIL.technical: Tight Stage 2 consolidation testing 20-session pivot at 4876.87 on 1.89× volume. Clean trend template with price perched above rising 21-EMA, 50-SMA, and 200-SMA; RSI at 70 indicates steady accumulation near record ground.
CRISIL.fundamental: Debt-free balance sheet with exceptional ~30% ROE and strong operating margins reflects dominant rating franchise moat. However, steady single-to-low-double-digit growth fails O'Neil's 25% EPS and 15% sales acceleration thresholds.
CRISIL.risk: Reversal below the 4597.26 stop or failure to hold the 50-SMA requires swift defensive exit.

CYIENT.technical: High-volume 20-day breakout past 1225.62 on 25.29× volume, printing fresh trailing-year highs above EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200. Heavy accumulation evident on the tape, though overhead resistance from prior cycles looms.
CYIENT.fundamental: Topline degrowth (-0.6% YoY) and 260 bps contraction in DET EBIT margins produced an 18.6% PAT drop. Subdued 8.6% ROE and sluggish engineering demand fail CANSLIM criteria completely.
CYIENT.risk: Breakdown below the 1112.61 breakout level signals institutional distribution and a failed trap; cut loss.

DCMSRIND.technical: Double bottom attempting a recovery above rising 50-SMA and 200-SMA at 57.54 on 3.43× volume with RSI at 72. Technical setup exhibits speculative bottoming rather than a pristine Stage 2 institutional base.
DCMSRIND.fundamental: Plagued by sugar sector headwinds and domestic quota restrictions, quarterly PAT collapsed 85.5% YoY with flat sales (+0.1%). Thin margins, high leverage, and modest 11% ROE fall far short of CANSLIM standards.
DCMSRIND.risk: Violation of double-bottom low at 48.88 invalidates the pattern; execute immediate stop discipline.
